title: 2025: dark matter, dark energy and the Hubble tension come from a non-equilibrium flow

statements.text: Dark matter is excess inertial response from temporal density gradients, dark energy is large-scale temporal pressure, and the Hubble tension is epoch-dependent relaxation of the conserved flow, with no new particles, vacuum energy terms or changes to the Einstein equations.

standing.reason: The author graded this claim superseded in his July 2026 Version 2.0 rebuild. No test has decided it.

sources.quote: dark matter appears as excess inertial response produced by temporal density gradients, dark energy emerges from large scale temporal pressure, and the Hubble tension follows from epoch dependent relaxation of the conserved flow.
